cohortCourses.title: Legionella & Water System Safety in Facilities

qualityRecords.question: Workplace Scenario (Sensor Calibration & BMS Drift): A facilities manager discovers that building occupants are complaining of cold drafts while chiller power consumption has spiked by 18%.
